name: Regular June 18, 2024 Planning Commission Meeting
agenda_text:
CHAIRPERSON MANALO

  VICE CHAIR DIAZ | COMMISSIONER FONSECA

  COMMISSIONER BARCELOS | COMMISSIONER PALHINHA

  CITY OF ARTESIA
  REGULAR PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING

  TUESDAY, June 18, 2024 | 7:00 p.m.

  PRIMARY LOCATION

  City Council Chambers of Artesia City Hall
  18747 Clarkdale Avenue
  (562) 865-6262

  AGENDA ITEMS
1.  Call to Order

2.  Invocation

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

4.  Roll Call of Commission

5.  Approval of Agenda

6.  Announcement of Speaker Slips

  For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item
  on the agenda, please complete a Speaker Slip located in the lobby or at the
  podium and deposit it with the Community Development Director prior to the
  commencement of the meeting. Please note that there is a five-minute time limit
  per speaker imposed. Please stay within this time limit.

7.  Public Comments for Items Not on the Agenda

8.  New Business – Non-Public Hearing (None)

9.  New Business – Public Hearing

  A.  Case No. 2024-13: A REQUEST FOR A DESIGN REVIEW FOR
  EXTERIOR AND INTERIOR MODIFICATIONS TO CONVERT TWO OF
  THE FOUR EXISTING DWELLING UNITS INTO ONE UNIT, A 407
  SQUARE FOOT FIRST FLOOR ADDITION AND A 1658 SQUARE FOOT

  1
   SECOND FLOOR ADDITION TO THE CONVERTED DWELLING UNIT,
  AND A NEW TWO CAR GARAGE LOCATED AT 18633 CORBY AVENUE
  IN THE MULTIPLE RESIDENTIAL (M-R) ZONE (CASE NO. 2024-13).
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

  B.  Case No. 2024-17: A REQUEST FOR 1) A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT
  TO ALLOW AN AUTOMATED DRIVE-THROUGH CARWASH WITH SELF-
  SERVICE VACUUM STATIONS 2) DESIGN REVIEW FOR A TWO STORY
  COMMERCIAL RETAIL BUILDING AND AN AUTOMATED DRIVE
  THROUGH CARWASH WITH ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGING
  STATIONS 3) DESIGN REVIEW FOR A COMPREHENSIVE SIGN
  PROGRAM AND 4) LOT MERGER FOR THE SUBJECT PROPERTY
  LOCATED AT 11701 SOUTH STREET WITHIN THE COMMERCIAL
  GENERAL (C-G) ZONE (CASE NO. 2024-17)
  STAFF REPORT

10.  Discussion/Report Items from Staff (None)

11.  Items from the Commission

12.  Adjournment to the Regular Planning Commission Meeting to be held on
  Tuesday, July 16, 2024, at 7:00 p.m., in the City Council Chambers of Artesia
  City Hall at 18747 Clarkdale Avenue, Artesia.
The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please contact
the Planning Department at (562) 865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
